visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing glasses and a black oversized t-shirt with light-colored shorts stands in a dim doorway. Behind him is a cluttered room filled with household storage, including white buckets and stacked items. He opens a door to reveal a brightly lit, spacious bathroom with white wall tiles and a wooden ceiling. (2) The camera follows the man as he enters the large bathroom. The room features white tiles on the walls, a wooden ceiling with exposed beams, a toilet, a pedestal sink, and a shower area with a pink plastic tub. He walks toward the center of the room, gesturing widely with his hands to emphasize the expansive space. (3) The man sits on the toilet, smiling and looking toward the camera while talking animatedly. He uses his hands to point at different corners of the room, highlighting the washing machine and various cleaning supplies. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from a small window near the sink. (4) He moves toward the small window and demonstrates the latch mechanism. He slides the window open and closed, pointing to the hook which is installed in an inverted position, hooking upwards. His facial expression is amused and playful as he shows this quirk of the room's construction. (5) Standing in the center of the bathroom, the man claps his hands together and speaks directly into the camera. The handheld camera pans slightly around the room to show the vast expanse of the tiled floor and the simple, functional fixtures before the scene concludes.
